rules.reason: Third-party and product-catalogue network identity colors are metadata, not CommunityGlows semantic UI palette values.
The dimensions are part of the browser popup feature-string protocol rather than rendered component styling.
CSS custom properties cannot be consumed in media-query conditions; this named site layout boundary is kept as a documented parser-level exception.
The native network registry mirrors catalogue identity colors used to distinguish third-party networks; these are metadata, not the CommunityGlows semantic palette.
The inline blocked-page document must fill its isolated WebView viewport; 100vh is a browser viewport contract while all authored component dimensions remain tokenized.
This call materializes a runtime RGB blend derived from a catalogue brand color, tokenized surface color, and tokenized blend fraction; it contains no raw palette literal.
